incident-bot: :rotating_light: billing-aggregator: token_count variance spike detected in europe-west (policy threshold 3x). auto-page sent.

sam (oncall): grabbing this, paging handoff noted. i'll triage live.

joan: saw the alert, quick check — ingestion lag on collector-c15, batches delayed ~7-12m, then bursts. counts look 'stuttery' not monotonic drift.

maria: how many customers affected? any overage flags firing to customers?

joan: preliminary: ~12 accounts in eu cluster showed transient overage flag events in the alerting pipeline. flags are generated downstream from the aggregate windower. data probably delayed, not duplicate charges.

kevin: i can run a fast window backfill to smooth aggregates. prepping job now. command: `./ops/backfill --service=billing-agg --start=1687653600 --end=1687654320 --fast-mode`

sam (oncall): @billing-bot can you mute customer-facing overage alerts for those 12 accounts while we stabilize? don't mute internal metrics.

billing-bot: Muting alert group `customer-overage-eu-west` for 12 accounts. Ticket BILL-1234 opened with tag `muted-temporary`.

joan: quick log snippet from collector-c15: ```ERROR aggregator window: seq_gap detected seq_last=45210 seq_recv=45231 delay_ms=730000``` looks like occasional consumer GC + kinesis retry pattern.

maria: prioritized mitigation: 1) mute customer overage notifications (done), 2) kick backfill (kevin), 3) monitor reconciliation, 4) notify CS for accounts with UI discrepancy.

kevin: backfill started, PID 7832. ETA ~8m for first pass. using low-priority to avoid impacting live ingestion. logs: `backfill[7832]: replaying 12k messages, 0 errors so far.`

sam (oncall): liaising with CS: pinged @emma-cs and @raj (account leads) to preempt inbound tickets. message: "We've identified transient usage reporting delays for a subset of EU accounts — no finalized billing; we're running a backfill and suppressing customer alerts."

joan: monitoring dashboards: post-backfill the token_count aggregates look aligned, variance down to 1.1x. will keep watch for 30m.

maria: customer impact assessment: UI shows missing usage for ~3 hours window for those accounts; customers MAY see zeroes in realtime usage until backfill completes. No invoices generated yet, no charges changed. recommend a proactive note in status page if backfill runs >30m.

sam (oncall): agreed. @maria can you draft a short status page blurb? keep it factual, avoid "billing error" language.

maria: drafting now: "We are investigating delayed usage reporting for a small number of EU customers. Usage ingestion is being backfilled and customer-facing alerts have been temporarily suppressed. No billing impact expected."

kevin: backfill finished first pass, reconciler reports 99.6% alignment. followup delta job queued for stragglers.

billing-bot: BILL-1234 updated: state=investigating -> in_progress. links: https://tickets.redwood/BILL-1234

joan: marking incident as "mitigated" for paging purposes while we watch the reconciliation queue. leaving oncall coverage to sam for final close.

sam (oncall): handing to followup owners: joan (root cause), kevin (backfill runbook tweaks), maria (customer comms). i'll close paging but keep slack thread pinned until postmortem.

sam (oncall): final note at 1687654920: mitigating steps worked, no customer billing changes; follow-up postmortem scheduled tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
